questions.question: Zelophehad had five daughters and no sons. What did the daughters ask Moses to give them?

answers.text: A seat among their clan's leaders

questions.question: When the five daughters of Zelophehad asked Moses for property, what did Moses do with their case?

answers.text: He brought it before the LORD
He handed it to the leaders
